name: Seismic
description: Seismic MCP Connector for Claude provides secure authentication and scoped access to Seismic, enabling Claude to generate accurate, context-aware responses grounded in approved content and tools.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Seismic to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Seismic to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.seismic.com/claude. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Seismic MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Seismic provides these MCP tools: generative_search_for_retrieving_contents, generative_search_for_answer_or_summary, and generate_livesend_link.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Seismic?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Seismic in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Seismic requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Seismic is developed by Seismic. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
